# Syl's Cleaning (Syl's Carpet & Upholstery Cleaning)

> Locally owned and operated professional cleaning company in southeastern Wisconsin, serving homes, businesses and apartment communities since 1977. Slogan: Reliability in Professional Cleaning.

## Services
- [Carpet & Upholstery Cleaning](https://sylscleaning.com/carpet-upholstery/): wall-to-wall carpet, spot and stain treatment, sofas, sectionals, chairs, mattresses, vehicle seats, carpet repair
- [Tile & Grout Cleaning](https://sylscleaning.com/tile-grout/): ceramic and porcelain tile, grout lines, kitchens, bathrooms, showers, entryways, commercial tile
- [Floor Care (Strip & Wax)](https://sylscleaning.com/floor-care/): stripping and waxing vinyl, VCT and other hard floors; apartment hallways, lobbies, offices; one-time or recurring
- [Area Rug Cleaning](https://sylscleaning.com/area-rugs/): everyday area rugs and oriental rugs
- [Commercial Cleaning](https://sylscleaning.com/commercial/): offices, apartment communities, churches, retail, medical and dental offices, schools, salons and rental turnovers; post-construction carpet and floor cleaning for new homes, remodels and contractor work; evening and Saturday appointments; one-time or recurring
